on_start.description: The main flow: it starts when the character is started.

life_below.description: When life falls below the threshold; re-arms above its re-arm value.

pods_above.description: When pods rise above the threshold; re-arms below its re-arm value.

fight_starts.description: The server starts a fight. Without this event, the fight AI fights it, then the flow resumes.

died.description: A fight is lost. Without this event, the character stops, blocked.

action_failed.description: An action ends Failed and its Failed output leads nowhere. Without this event, the character stops, blocked with the reason.

harvest_until.description: Harvests the chosen resources in the zone until pods reach the threshold.

deposit_all_but.description: Opens the bank and deposits everything but what is kept.

hunt_until.description: Fights the zone's monsters until pods reach the threshold.

notify.description: An alert in the app, then what follows.

if.description: Chooses what follows by the condition.

wait_for_life.description: Stays where it is, out of a fight, until life, which comes back alone, reaches the threshold.

finish.description: Stops the blueprint: the character is "Finished".

sequence.description: Runs its outputs one after another, each once the one before has ended; the last is the rest of the flow.

switch.description: Follows the output of the case the value is, or Otherwise.

repeat.description: Runs its body that many times, its index from 1 to N, then Completed: a loop.

while.description: Runs its body while the condition holds, read before each pass, then Completed: a loop.

for_each.description: Runs its body for each element of the list, read once as it enters, with the element and its index, then Completed: a loop.

leave_loop.description: Ends the nearest loop's body, which goes on out of its Completed.

do_n_times.description: Goes on its first N times, then no more until Reset re-arms it; its memory lasts the whole run.

alternate.description: Goes out of First, then Second, then First, each time the flow comes in; its memory lasts the whole run.

pick.description: Gives the list's element picked least recently, in turn while the list does not change; its memory lasts the whole run.

wait_until.description: Waits until the condition holds, read at each change and each second, then Then; after At most, Too long (0: no limit).

block.description: Blocks the character with this reason.

pause_notify.description: Tells the player this text and pauses the run; it resumes after this node.

retry.description: Runs its try; an unlinked Failed inside it starts another, up to N tries, the first included, then Failed with the reason.

life_percent.description: Life, as a percentage of its maximum.

pods_percent.description: Pods, as a percentage of their maximum.

job_resources.description: The resources this profession harvests, read in the game's data.

greater_or_equal.description: True when the first value reaches the second.

minutes.description: A duration of so many minutes.

return_done.description: The function ends, giving back its outputs.

return_failed.description: The function ends Failed, with the reason.

my_event.description: Starts when Trigger fires this event of mine, with its inputs.

return_exit.description: The function ends by one of its named exits, with its outputs.

result.description: What a pure function gives back: its outputs.

equal.description: True when both values are the same, of any type.

not_equal.description: True when the two values differ.

less.description: True when A is less than B: numbers, percentages, durations or times.

less_or_equal.description: True when A is less than or equal to B.

greater.description: True when A is greater than B.

between.description: True when the value lies between both bounds, included; 23:00 to 08:00 goes past midnight.

and.description: True when all its conditions hold, read in order up to the first false.

or.description: True when one of its conditions holds, read in order up to the first true.

choose.description: Gives one value when the condition holds, another otherwise; only the side taken is read.
